description: Branch R-FMT-1 II-04 / R-FMT-2 Calculated wrappers (public side) on an ACCDB. CD(ID Long, A Long, B Text(20), C Text(255) calculated as [B] & '-' & CStr([A])) is made through CreateTableDef; row (1, 5, 'x') is inserted and read. Then one change at a time, each read back after it: A = 6; B = Null; A = Null; an UPDATE that sets C directly; ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN A (a column C depends on); the field A renamed through Field.Name; Field C's Expression put to another text after creation. Asks when the stored result is recomputed, whether C can be written, and what is refused.
